dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったるかったな……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh...... what a pain......"
dialogues.text: "Ahh...... what a pain......"

dialogues.jp: グッと伸びをして、こった身体をほぐす。
dialogues.en: I stretched to relax my body.
dialogues.text: I stretched to relax my body.

dialogues.jp:
学長のお決まりの挨拶を延々と聞かされ、入学
式は無事終了した。
dialogues.en:
After the never ending speech by the principal, the entrance
ceremony had finally ended.
dialogues.text:
After the never ending speech by the principal, the entrance
ceremony had finally ended.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まったくだ。壇上で喋るときはもっと手を振
　りかざし、声を張り上げて、行うべきだ」
dialogues.en:
"You're right. He should've screamed out and waved his hands
about."
dialogues.text:
"You're right. He should've screamed out and waved his hands
about."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それも、違う気がするが……しかし、また
　おまえと同じクラスとはな」
dialogues.en:
"No, that's not what I meant to say...... Anyway, why are we
in the same class again......?"
dialogues.text:
"No, that's not what I meant to say...... Anyway, why are we
in the same class again......?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うむ。確かに何者かの陰謀の可能性があるな」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... This might be some kind of conspiracy."
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... This might be some kind of conspiracy."

dialogues.jp:
誰がなんの目的でこんなことに陰謀をはりめぐ
らすのか、ぜひ説明してもらいたいものだ。
dialogues.en:
I'd like to know who would try to plot against us and for
what reason......
dialogues.text:
I'd like to know who would try to plot against us and for
what reason......

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並が、俺の背後に視線を向ける。背後霊でも
見えたか？
dialogues.en:
He was looking over my shoulders. Did he see a ghost or
something?
dialogues.text:
He was looking over my shoulders. Did he see a ghost or
something?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 後ろを振り向くと萌先輩と眞子がいた。
dialogues.en: When I turned back, Moe-sempai and Mako were there.
dialogues.text: When I turned back, Moe-sempai and Mako were there.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、萌先輩」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Moe-sempai."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Moe-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、知り合いなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you guys know each other?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, you guys know each other?"

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩のことをさして、杉並が言う。
dialogues.en: Suginami asked while he pointed at Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: Suginami asked while he pointed at Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、ご入学おめでとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations on your enrollment, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations on your enrollment, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「どうも。萌先輩も、新入生歓迎の演奏お疲れ
　さま」
dialogues.en:
"Thanks. Good job with your performance during the ceremony,
Moe-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"Thanks. Good job with your performance during the ceremony,
Moe-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いっぱい失敗してしまいました」
dialogues.en: "I made a lot of mistakes."
dialogues.text: "I made a lot of mistakes."

dialogues.jp:
たしかに、素人の俺でも音が外れてるのが分かっ
たからなぁ……。
dialogues.en: She's right. Even I could tell that her notes were off......
dialogues.text: She's right. Even I could tell that her notes were off......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんま練習した意味なかったかも……」
dialogues.en: "I guess all that practice didn't mean much......"
dialogues.text: "I guess all that practice didn't mean much......"

dialogues.jp: 隣で眞子が諦めた顔をしている。
dialogues.en: Mako stood beside her with a disappointed face.
dialogues.text: Mako stood beside her with a disappointed face.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんは何組になったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Which class are you in, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Which class are you in, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「３組です」
dialogues.en: "I'm in class 3."
dialogues.text: "I'm in class 3."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですか。眞子ちゃんと違うクラスに
　なったんですね」
dialogues.en:
"Is that so? You're in a different class from Mako this
time, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Is that so? You're in a different class from Mako this
time, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そういや眞子はどこになったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Which class are you in, Mako?"
dialogues.text: "Which class are you in, Mako?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「１組だ」
dialogues.en: "She's in class 1."
dialogues.text: "She's in class 1."

dialogues.jp:
なんでお前が答えるんだ？　っていうか、どう
して知ってる。
dialogues.en: Why's he answering? Moreover, why does he know that?
dialogues.text: Why's he answering? Moreover, why does he know that?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What is it?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なんであんたが、あたしのクラスを知ってん
　のよ」
dialogues.en: "How do you know what class I'm in?"
dialogues.text: "How do you know what class I'm in?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「フッ……戦略の基本は、まずは情報収集から。
　世界の常識だぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm...... Collecting information is the most basic tactic.
That's common knowledge!"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm...... Collecting information is the most basic tactic.
That's common knowledge!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……頭イタ」
dialogues.en: "......My head hurts."
dialogues.text: "......My head hurts."

dialogues.jp: げんなりと呟く。
dialogues.en: She muttered with disgust.
dialogues.text: She muttered with disgust.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「足は大丈夫でしたか？」
dialogues.en: "How does your leg feel?"
dialogues.text: "How does your leg feel?"

dialogues.jp: 実に心配そうな表情を見せる。
dialogues.en: She asked me with a concerned look on her face.
dialogues.text: She asked me with a concerned look on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「ええ。別に今日は入学式だけでしたし」
dialogues.en:
"It's fine. Plus, the ceremony was the only thing I had
scheduled today."
dialogues.text:
"It's fine. Plus, the ceremony was the only thing I had
scheduled today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか。よかったです」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad to hear that."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad to hear that."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「でも、学園に通うの大変じゃないですか？」
dialogues.en: "But isn't it causing you trouble to get to the school?"
dialogues.text: "But isn't it causing you trouble to get to the school?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いやそれほどでも……」
dialogues.en: "It's not that bad......"
dialogues.text: "It's not that bad......"

dialogues.jp: ちと歩くスピードが遅くなるぐらいだし。
dialogues.en:
My walking speed has decreasing a little, but but it's not a
big deal.
dialogues.text:
My walking speed has decreasing a little, but but it's not a
big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、鞄は持てんだろう」
dialogues.en: "But I bet you can't hold your bag."
dialogues.text: "But I bet you can't hold your bag."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「確かに」
dialogues.en: "That's true."
dialogues.text: "That's true."

dialogues.jp:
両手が｛ふさ／塞｝がるから持ちようがない。あとは肩に
引っ掛けるしかないか。
dialogues.en:
Both of my hands will be holding the crutches, so I just
have to hang it over my shoulder.
dialogues.text:
Both of my hands will be holding the crutches, so I just
have to hang it over my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、私がお迎えにいきますね」
dialogues.en: "Then, I'll come pick you up."
dialogues.text: "Then, I'll come pick you up."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はいっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「荷物持ちです」
dialogues.en: "I'll hold your bag."
dialogues.text: "I'll hold your bag."

dialogues.jp: 何のためらいも見せずにニッコリ微笑む。
dialogues.en: She smiled softly without hesitation.
dialogues.text: She smiled softly without hesitation.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「明日から、お迎えに行きます」
dialogues.en: "I'll come get you from tomorrow on."
dialogues.text: "I'll come get you from tomorrow on."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ言い切る萌先輩に、押し流されるよう
にして頷く。
dialogues.en: I nodded as I was pushed by Moe-sempai's big smile.
dialogues.text: I nodded as I was pushed by Moe-sempai's big smile.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、女の子に迎えに来てもらうとい
うのは、結構ハズイかも……。
dialogues.en:
It's kind of embarrassing to have a girl come pick you
up......
dialogues.text:
It's kind of embarrassing to have a girl come pick you
up......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「別に荷物なんてないと思うけど？　教科書は
　机の中だし」
dialogues.en:
"He's not going to have much to carry though...... All his
text books are going to be kept inside his desk......"
dialogues.text:
"He's not going to have much to carry though...... All his
text books are going to be kept inside his desk......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いくらなんでも、まだ何も入ってないって」
dialogues.en: "But I don't have them in there yet."
dialogues.text: "But I don't have them in there yet."

dialogues.jp: あるのは今日もらったプリントぐらいだ。
dialogues.en: All I have in there is the handout papers that I got today.
dialogues.text: All I have in there is the handout papers that I got today.

dialogues.jp: 「しまった。プリントを机の中に置き忘れた」
dialogues.en: "Shoot!! I left the handouts in the desk!"
dialogues.text: "Shoot!! I left the handouts in the desk!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「今日、配られたやつ？」
dialogues.en: "You mean the ones you got today?"
dialogues.text: "You mean the ones you got today?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
うーむ、どうしよう。たしか明日、提出しなきゃ
いけないのがあったハズだ。
dialogues.en:
Hmm...... what should I do? I'm sure there was something I
had to turn in by tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
Hmm...... what should I do? I'm sure there was something I
had to turn in by tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩、ちょっと取ってきてもらえます？」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai, would you please go get them for me?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai, would you please go get them for me?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
にこやかに返事を返して、萌先輩が小走りに走
り去っていく。
dialogues.en: She answered with a smile and ran off to get them.
dialogues.text: She answered with a smile and ran off to get them.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なに、今の。なんでお姉ちゃんが、あんたの
　忘れ物を取りに行かされるのよ」
dialogues.en:
"What was that? Why does my sister have to go get your
stuff?"
dialogues.text:
"What was that? Why does my sister have to go get your
stuff?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「え？　いや、看病されているときの癖でつい」
dialogues.en: "What? I guess I'm used to being taken care of by her......"
dialogues.text: "What? I guess I'm used to being taken care of by her......"

dialogues.jp:
なんか萌先輩にお願いするのが自然になってた
から、普通に人前でも指示だしちゃったな。
dialogues.en:
It became natural for me to ask her to do things for me, so
I accidentally asked her again in front of people.
dialogues.text:
It became natural for me to ask her to do things for me, so
I accidentally asked her again in front of people.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ご主人様とメイドさんの関係か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you guys the master and the maid?"
dialogues.text: "Are you guys the master and the maid?"

dialogues.jp: まあ、見方によってはそう見えなくもないが。
dialogues.en: I guess some people will take it like that......
dialogues.text: I guess some people will take it like that......

dialogues.jp: いいかも、その関係……。

春の陽気をあびながら、俺はメイドを待つご主
人様の気分に、浸ってみるのだった……。
dialogues.en: I think I like that......
dialogues.text: I think I like that......

dialogues.jp: ◆入学◆
dialogues.en: ◆Enrollment◆
dialogues.text: ◆Enrollment◆

dialogues.jp: 入学式が終わり、萌先輩達と合流した。
dialogues.en:
The entrance ceremony was over, and I met Moe-sempai and
Mako.
dialogues.text:
The entrance ceremony was over, and I met Moe-sempai and
Mako.

dialogues.jp:
松葉杖を着いている俺を心配したらしく、萌先
輩が、荷物持ちのために、朝、迎えに来てくれ
る事に決まった。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai was concerned about me using the crutches, so she
decided to come and pick me up in the morning to hold my
bag.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai was concerned about me using the crutches, so she
decided to come and pick me up in the morning to hold my
bag.
